content:
# MSS-AI 生产部署指南

## 元信息
- ID: H451
- 日期: 2026-06-03
- 分类: 运维/部署
- 关联: H141 (六公理), H447 (VDP工具链), H450 (跨模型基准)

## 1. 模型选择

### 生产推荐: v3.4
```bash
ollama run mss-ai-v3_4:latest
# Score: 100% | Violations: 0 | Thermal Tax: 0 | Speed: 2.7s
# 4K context | temperature 0.05
```

### 备选（如需32K上下文）: v3.6
```bash
ollama run mss-ai-v3_6:latest
# Score: 100% | Speed: 5.6s (2x slower than v3.4)
```

### 不推荐
- v3.5: 97% (唯一回归版本)
- v3.7: 100%但3.2x慢于v3.4 (8.7s)
- v3.8/v3.9: 实验废弃

## 2. VDP审计工具链

### 启动服务
```bash
# 确保服务运行 (Windows Service, 端口53000)
net start MssSkillApi

# 验证
curl http://127.0.0.1:53000/health
```

### 核心端点

| 端点 | 用途 |
|:---|:---|
| POST /audit | 完整审计 (v3.9 JSON) |
| POST /audit?format=html | HTML仪表盘 |
| POST /vdp/scan | VDP扫描 |
| POST /vdp/anchor | 锚点检查 (strictness 0.0-1.0) |
| POST /vdp/precommit | 静态代码分析 |
| GET /kb/search?q=xxx | KB向量搜索 |
| GET /health | 状态检查 |

### 一键审计
```bash
# 1. 写入LLM输出到 audit_input.txt
# 2. (可选) 写入参考事实到 audit_ref.txt
# 3. 双击 run_audit.bat
# 4. 浏览器自动打开 audit_report.html
```

### 命令行
```bash
python unified_audit.py --ref reference.txt --output llm_output.txt
python benchmark_runner.py --self-test  # 37/37 should be 100%
```

## 7. 快速恢复命令

```bash
# 全栈健康检查
curl http://127.0.0.1:53000/health
ollama list | Select-String v3_4
python -c "from benchmark_runner import CheckEngine; print('VDP OK')"

# 生成审计报告
python -c "from report_generator import audit_to_html; audit_to_html('test output', 'reference', output_path='report.html')"

# KB搜索

```
